style: One background character for a 1990s point-and-click adventure game set in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria in June 1996, painted as if by the same artist who painted the people in the reference image: the same smooth, clean painted look, soft broad shading, flat clean colour with a few soft folds, clean thin outlines, the same muted palette and lighting, the same realistic proportions (head about one eighth of the body height), not a caricature.
end: Full body with feet, on a flat plain green background, no floor, no shadow.

extras.desc: A waiter at a museum reception: a man in his thirties in a white waiter's jacket, black trousers and bow tie, walking, carrying a silver tray of champagne flutes on one raised hand. Seen from the side, walking. (redone: standing)
A waitress at a museum reception: a young woman in a black dress with a white apron, hair tied back, holding out a tray of canapés with both hands, smiling politely. Three-quarter view.

A guest at a museum reception: a Canarian man in his fifties in a pale linen suit and open-necked shirt, holding a glass of red wine, mid-conversation, gesturing with his free hand. Three-quarter view.
A guest at a museum reception: an elegant woman in her sixties in a dark green evening dress and pearls, grey hair in a chignon, holding a glass of white wine, listening. Three-quarter view.

Two guests networking at a tall round cocktail table with a white cloth: a man in a dark suit and a woman in a red dress, each with a glass of wine, leaning on the table, talking. Seen from the side; the table and both people fully visible.
A guest at a museum reception: a young bearded academic in his thirties in a tweed jacket and open shirt, glasses, holding a glass of red wine and a museum brochure, laughing. Three-quarter view.

On Las Canteras beach: a woman in her forties sunbathing, lying on her back on a striped beach towel, in a modest one-piece swimsuit, sunglasses and a straw hat over her face, a paperback beside her. Seen from the side; the whole towel and figure visible.

On Las Canteras beach: a father in swimming shorts kneeling with his small son, building a sandcastle with a red bucket and spade; the little sandcastle between them. Seen from the side; everything visible.
On Las Canteras beach: an old Canarian man in a straw hat, white vest and rolled-up trousers, sitting in a folding beach chair reading a newspaper. Three-quarter view; the whole chair visible.
On the beach promenade: a German tourist in his fifties in a bucket hat, short-sleeved shirt, shorts and sandals with socks, a camera round his neck, looking at a folded map. Three-quarter view.
On Las Canteras beach: a young man surfer with short sun-bleached hair in board shorts, standing and waxing a surfboard propped upright beside him. Three-quarter view.

In the old town square of Vegueta: an old woman in a black dress and cardigan sitting on a wooden park bench, scattering breadcrumbs for pigeons from a paper bag; two pigeons at her feet. Three-quarter view; the whole bench visible.

In the old town of Vegueta: a lottery-ticket seller, a man in his sixties in a cap and a grey jacket, strips of lottery tickets pinned to his jacket and held up in one hand, calling out. Three-quarter view.
In the old town of Vegueta: a British tourist woman in her sixties in a sun visor and floral blouse, looking up at a building, holding an open guidebook. Three-quarter view.
Inside the cathedral of Santa Ana: an old woman in black with a black lace mantilla, kneeling on a low wooden kneeler in prayer, a rosary in her hands. Seen from the side; the kneeler visible.
Inside the cathedral of Santa Ana: a young woman tourist in a long skirt and cardigan over her shoulders, looking up at the vaulted ceiling in wonder, a small camera in her hands. Three-quarter view.
Inside the cathedral of Santa Ana: an elderly priest in a black cassock and white collar, walking slowly with a prayer book held against his chest. Seen from the side, walking. (redone: standing)

In a 1990s seaside hotel restaurant: a waiter in his forties in a white jacket, black trousers and bow tie, a white napkin over his arm, pouring red wine from a bottle into a glass held at waist height. Three-quarter view. (redone: relaxed, white short-sleeved shirt and apron)

On the fishing quay of La Isleta: an old fisherman in a flat cap and a faded blue work shirt, sitting on an upturned wooden fish crate, mending a fishing net spread across his knees with a netting needle. Three-quarter view; the crate visible.

On the fishing quay of La Isleta: a strong fisherman in his forties in rubber boots, rolled-up sleeves and an apron, carrying a wooden crate of silver fish on his shoulder. Seen from the side, walking. (redone: standing)

On the fishing quay of La Isleta: two old fishermen in caps standing and talking, one leaning on a bollard and smoking, the other with his hands in his pockets. Seen from the side; both fully visible.
An empty table like Gail and Derek's: white cloth, two rattan chairs, set for two.
Gail and Derek at their table (in the game: two clickable halves).
